tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background — a warm cream by day, a deep plum for 3 a.m. feeds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells, segmented-control tracks, progress tracks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and surface (12:1 / 15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, captions, secondary labels on bg and surface (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main call to action fill (Start timer, Save). Soft coral — always carries on-primary text, never white.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (7.5:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around any interactive element (≥5.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete entry, fever readings. Text and icons only on bg/surface.

tokens.name: feed-tint
tokens.usage: Feeding — peach. Icon wells, chips, card accents for breast, bottle and solids.

tokens.name: feed-ink
tokens.usage: Feeding text and icons on feed-tint (4.9:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: pump-tint
tokens.usage: Pumping — rose. Pump sessions and the milk stash.

tokens.name: pump-ink
tokens.usage: Pumping text and icons on pump-tint (5.6:1 / 7.6:1).

tokens.name: sleep-tint
tokens.usage: Sleep — lavender. Naps and night sleep.

tokens.name: sleep-ink
tokens.usage: Sleep text and icons on sleep-tint (4.6:1 / 7.1:1).

tokens.name: diaper-tint
tokens.usage: Diaper — mint. Wet, dirty, mixed.

tokens.name: diaper-ink
tokens.usage: Diaper text and icons on diaper-tint (5.3:1 / 7.7:1).

tokens.name: med-tint
tokens.usage: Medication — butter. Dose entries, the medication list, next-allowed-dose chips.

tokens.name: med-ink
tokens.usage: Medication text and icons on med-tint (5.8:1 / 7.6:1).

tokens.name: milestone-tint
tokens.usage: Milestones & growth — sky. Firsts, developmental milestones, weight, length and head size.

tokens.name: milestone-ink
tokens.usage: Milestone text and icons on milestone-tint (5.5:1 / 7.6:1).
